body.name: Conditional endpoint-mixture causal-completion handle
body.construction: Retain the complete observed outcome vector under its realized canonical path \(p^G\); use common conditional latent uniforms to construct the unobserved \(p^\infty\) vector and every off-path \(p^r\) vector with prescribed cohort--time means; use one gauge per connected component before the mixture step to meet the bounded-support inequalities.
